title: OrderPaymentFailed
description: EventBridge `detail` for a subscription order that failed to materialize or be paid for. Producer: milkful.order (MA-132). Consumers: Notification Service (future); Reporting.

amountPaise.description: 0 for DELIVERY_ADDRESS_UNKNOWN/PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE — the order failed before a price was ever obtained. Strictly positive for INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE/WALLET_NOT_ACTIVE, which always have a real quoted amount.
